reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through our expense app and it works fine, so I'm not adding a second tool and another monthly bill just to get the same receipts into a Google Sheet. Half of what I spend is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a receipt bot doesn't fix my real headache anyway.
objection: I don't believe it really catches duplicates. Two mechanics send a photo of the same parts invoice, or someone sends a screenshot and then the paper copy. Does it actually spot that, or is it just a bot that turns a receipt into a table row?
would_change_my_mind: If my bookkeeper ran the free 30 documents through it, it caught real duplicates and wrong totals our current app missed, and it pushed straight into Jurnal or Zoho instead of a separate sheet.
